preconditions.description: The first line of input contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 8) representing the count of distinct integers.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(x) <= 10**12 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: The second line contains n distinct space-separated integers ai (2 ≤ ai ≤ 10^12).

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of vertices in a divisor tree that contains each of the input integers ai.
